title: Bindu Rakapikwa Mambakwedza
intro: Munguva yerunyararo zuva risati rabuda, hurongwa hwakaitwa muchivande. Nhaka inokura yakamira yakagadzirira kukohwa, asi chisarudzo chakaitwa chekuchengetedza michero yese kure nevanoshaya. Mangwanani, zvese zvaizoita sezvisingazivikanwe, uye chidzidzo chaizove chakavezwa kuita matavi matema kune vese vanofungisisa.
clues: Takagara nhaka bindu rakanaka uye takavimbisa kukohwa michero yaro yese kuti tiwane isu pachedu.
Takapika kuti taizobuda mangwanani-ngwanani varombo vaikumbira mugove wavo vachiri vakarara.
Takabvisa chero chinhu chipi zvacho chatakanga tavimbisa uye takanyima kodzero dzevanoshaya tisingataure kana Allah achida.
Takabuda tichizevezerana kuti pasabvumidzwe murombo kupinda mubindu redu musi iwoyo.
Takazvifungidzira tichikwanisa kuunganidza zvese uye kudzivirira chero munhu anounganidza kuti asatore chikamu.
Takamuka tikaona bindu redu raparadzwa husiku, rakasviba sekunge rakakohwewa, uye takati taive tisina mari uye taive tava kupfidza.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
